commands.description: Your team's shared sessions, one click to join: /team [signin | create <name> | invite | signout]

commands.description: Invite a teammate into this shared session, in their Claude Code: /invite <name>

commands.name: stop-sharing
commands.description: Stop sharing this session, or leave the one you joined

commands.name: room
commands.description: Open the Room: who is here, activity, side chat
commands.output: This session is not shared. Press Share above the prompt, or type /share-session.

commands.name: share-file
commands.description: Show a file to everyone in the shared session: /share-file <path>
commands.output: Share this session first: press Share or type /share-session.

commands.name: share-preview
commands.description: Let teammates open this machine's localhost: /share-preview <port> [title]
commands.output: Share this session first: press Share or type /share-session.
